about: Which runs count as evidence. Every run belongs to one batch; only batches with status 'study' feed a result. Everything else is kept as the record of how FusionEdges was built. Edit this file (not the database) to change a label; the Analysis tab reads it.

statuses.exploration: Trying things out. Mixed models, failed AI calls, one task. Not evidence.
statuses.pilot: First structured comparison. Too small and not pinned to one model. Shapes the questions, answers none.
statuses.development: Runs used to build and fix FusionEdges. The rules were changed after seeing these results, so they cannot test it.
statuses.preliminary: A fair comparison on tasks that were also used for development. Shows direction, not proof.
statuses.study: Frozen pipeline, fresh tasks, analysis fixed in advance. The only batches a result may come from.

batches.title: Early runs (15-18 Oct)
batches.what: One navbar task, prompt vs report, four different models, several failed AI calls.

batches.title: Pilot (27 Oct)
batches.what: 4 navbar tasks, agent alone vs agent + report, then the first port runs. Models mixed after a quota fallback.

batches.title: Port v1 (1 Nov)
batches.what: First rule-based port on 16 tasks, no browser check.

batches.title: Port v2 (1 Nov)
batches.what: Rules added after v1's failures; first browser check.

batches.title: Preliminary navbar comparison (2 Nov)
batches.what: 16 navbar tasks: agent alone (2 runs each, gemini-3.5-flash-lite) vs port v3 (no AI), with a side-by-side review. Fair setup, but the port's rules were written while looking at these tasks.

batches.title: Adaptive pilot v1 (2 Nov)
batches.what: 7 of 32 runs across navbar, footer, card, accordion; adaptive runs crashed on a Gemini tool-call bug.

batches.title: Six-run diagnostic attempts (2 Nov evening)
batches.what: Card, accordion, footer on two familiar hosts; stopped by the gemini-3.6-flash free quota.

batches.title: Study 1: navbar, Next.js donor into a React site
batches.what: Frozen pipeline (port v4 + adaptive), ~30 fresh tasks, agent alone vs FusionEdges, 2 runs each, gemini-3.5-flash-lite, blind review of a sample. See experiments/study-1/PLAN.md.
